ai_summary: Bajaj Finserv Limited has formally incorporated Bajaj Reinsurance Limited as a wholly-owned subsidiary, signaling a strategic expansion into the reinsurance business. This new entity, established with an initial capital of INR 1 crore, aims to diversify the company's financial services portfolio. While an NOC for incorporation has been obtained from IRDAI, its ability to commence reinsurance operations remains contingent upon securing further regulatory approvals.
